title: llmco event
description: An event of the company's journal, in .llmco/journal/<event-id>.json, the id being the time it happened followed by a random suffix. Written by llmco and never modified: the journal keeps, in git, what happened in the company. Every event has a type, the time it happened and a depth; its other fields are its type's.
